pages.text: Today the alley children are having a race. They will run from the end of the alley to the bakery.
Coco's legs are short. Still, Coco wants to run all the way to the finish.
Grandpa Mole would cheer. "I'll wait at the finish line!"
Go! The children rushed off. The alley bent this way and that.
At a fork, Coco looked around. Grandpa's voice came from one side. "This way!"
Coco followed the voice. Grandpa was waving by the well. It wasn't the finish line.
"Oh, isn't this the place?" Grandpa looked around.
Coco looked up at the sky. Smoke curled from a chimney. It was their bakery chimney!
Coco ran hard toward the smoke. Those short legs flew along.
Coco ran all the way to the finish! By the well, Grandpa was still waving.
